7deb401d-52f2-413d-b845-e3a109fde60e.data: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.
7deb401d-52f2-413d-b845-e3a109fde60e.text_lemmatized: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.

0b10af99-b01d-42e4-b448-04098e5225cb.data: In Prophase, the chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.
0b10af99-b01d-42e4-b448-04098e5225cb.text_lemmatized: In Prophase, the chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.

47e0d11b-db06-4f7d-a71e-52e053a2d4ca.data: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.
47e0d11b-db06-4f7d-a71e-52e053a2d4ca.text_lemmatized: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.

ca4902ff-1957-4ab6-9a54-2b49a3780897.data: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid going to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
ca4902ff-1957-4ab6-9a54-2b49a3780897.text_lemmatized: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid going to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
